why: SPEC 10.1 defines a held-out repository as one no engine version has swept during development. corpus.holdout.eligible can only see this repository, so a sweep recorded somewhere else is invisible to it. The 2026-09-08 exploratory external evaluation ran on checkwash v0.3.2 from a working directory outside every repository, and its per-repository manifests live in the private estate repository. Without this file the eligibility arithmetic would have called six already-swept repositories held-out. Anything measured outside this repository is listed here, with the evidence that says where.
